abstract: Maintains perimeter access clearances and vault physical footprint records
system_message:
You are Physical security superintendent (PSS). The physical security superintendent (PSS) maintains perimeter access clearances, vault physical footprint records, and perimeter patrol frequency documentation across evaluated candidate repository facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains perimeter access clearances and vault physical footprint records（SECP）
information_points.content:
PSS-SECP-HR2：Pine Valley Secure Deep Storage does not have perimeter biometric access clearance for its outer and inner airlock portals, and its gross secure storage area encompasses 2400 m2 within the hardened subterranean vault envelope.
PSS-SECP-JCX：For Highland Subterranean Vault Complex, perimeter biometric access clearance is confirmed based on certified dual-factor biometric infrastructure across outer and inner airlock portals, and the gross secure storage area within the hardened subterranean perimeter measures 4000 m2.
PSS-SECP-AIA：Granite Ridge Archival Repository holds perimeter biometric access clearance across its outer and inner airlock portals, while the gross secure storage area within the hardened subterranean vault perimeter is 4000 m2.

information_points.title: Perimeter patrol frequency（PATROL）
information_points.content:
PSS-PATROL-PNB：Granite Ridge Archival Repository records 8 rounds/d for daily physical guard patrol rounds along the outer security boundary and exclusion zone.
PSS-PATROL-RYC：Pine Valley Secure Deep Storage conducts 6 rounds/d for daily physical guard patrol rounds covering its outer security boundary and exclusion zone.
PSS-PATROL-CB2：Highland Subterranean Vault Complex logs 12 rounds/d for daily physical guard patrol rounds across the outer security boundary and exclusion zone.
